reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on 3-Nov-2025.

Two sources back that up:
- **Moss's Coastal digest of 2-Nov-2025:** it says ownership changes hands "tomorrow".
- **Bettina's cutover recap of 8-Dec-2025:** it gives the same date.

The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025, and Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I put that in the reply, but said 3-Nov-2025 is the date for the coverage tracker. I wrote the dates in her 3-Nov-2025 format.
